notes: Backlog game, added from the docs/PLAN.md candidate list. Route cc-by-sa: StrategyWiki (CC BY-SA 4.0) is at completion stage 1, with 60 written subpages (about 379,000 characters). Its walkthrough has written pages for every main mission up to Rank B, plus many side missions, the Pokédex, TMs and Z-A Royale trainers. The Rank A and finale pages are listed but not written. Chapters follow its contents order, grouped by rank; titles are reworded and no text was copied. Some subpages sit under the unaccented "Pokemon Legends: Z-A/" prefix. pokemon.fandom.com also answers the API.
